Overview

Areas around the African Union and Economic Commission for Africa involve heightened security. Even residential moves may pass checkpoints where IDs and vehicle papers are inspected.

Checkpoint planning

  • Carry government ID for every adult and work ID if entering institutional compounds.
  • Avoid move days coinciding with major summits or heads-of-state visits when roads tighten.
  • Keep inventory list available if security asks what is in sealed boxes.

Building coordination

Property managers often cap concurrent moves. Book lift and loading bay before confirming truck dispatch.

Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.
